_about: One labelled draft for scripts/gate_eval.py. `expect` is what the gate must do with it: block (the claim checks stop it), flag (a reviewer names the house-style fault; it is advice and never blocks) or pass. `rule` is the check it tests: claims, or one of the house-style rules a person may retire from the code (hook, tag line, cta, shape) once the reviewers catch every case of it. Every name, claim id and theme is the fixture brand's (tests/fixtures/memory).
why: The same hook form, opening and closing as the three pieces before it.

item.title: One thing holds. Another thing does not.
item.post:
On 2 November a regulator did a thing.

The middle of the argument.

What we do not claim: nothing in this post asserts a deployed Acme capability.
item.teaser_linkedin:
A wallet holds a credential. It does not decide which root issued it.

The wallet programme is engineering. The root a company credential chains to is governance, and it is still open. That choice decides whether the credential is portable or merely valid at home.
